about: SCION 23 assets. No found footage, no kit images, no Quick, Draw! drawings and no web images were used; everything on screen and in the sound was made by the scripts in build/.

assets.what: the dog's painted parts: torso for body views 0/45/90/135 deg, head for views 0/45/68/90/112/135/180, neck (dorsal stripe left/right), three ears (side near/far, back), seven leg segments in near (lit) and far (shadowed) versions, tail
assets.source: painted in code: build/atlas.py + build/paint.py -> actor/actors.png, actor/actors.atlas, actor/actors.atlas.json
assets.operation: drawn/synthesized: silhouettes of torso and head laid out from ellipsoid volumes on a projected turnaround sheet (build/turnaround.py, a guide ray-cast once at paint time), rounded and shaded as a soft height field in banded gouache tones (cool shadows, warm lights), dry-brush strokes, wash, paper grain, a broken warm outline; limbs, neck, tail and ears are painted 2D tapered shapes

assets.what: the person: profile head with hair, torso, arms, hands, legs, shoes (near/far)
assets.operation: painted in code, same gouache; no likeness

assets.what: runtime skeleton JSON: 28 bones, 20 slots, 4 IK constraints, default skin with region and weighted mesh attachments
assets.operation: authored: setup pose and attachment placement baked from the turnaround sheet

assets.what: clip library: idle, cringe-back, turn-away, lie, look-back (head track), rise, stalk-walk, lie-across, look-in (head track), settle
assets.operation: keyed acting parameters, baked every 2 frames to absolute 2D bone values, attachment, draw-order and IK-mix timelines, events

assets.what: the track timeline the film plays
assets.operation: authored against the score's choice times

assets.what: person skeleton and its one clip baked from the score's person channels
assets.operation: authored 2D poses blended by the score (sit, reach, hand low, voice)

assets.what: porch and room cross-section at dusk, door leaf, light from the doorway
assets.operation: painted in code (gouache layers, strokes, grain); door mapped onto its swing per angle

assets.what: formant voice (calls, soft voice), crickets, room tone, paw falls, thump, whimper, collar jingle, sigh, door creak, the room's warmth
assets.operation: synthesized; paw falls are the runtime foot planner's touch-down events, the rest are clip events

assets.what: Big Shoulders Display, JetBrains Mono, Literata
assets.rights: SIL Open Font License (repository font set)

assets.operation: read: root x, choice times, person channels, door, voice windows
